breed-size.quote: a tasty snack for dogs of all sizes

texts.about_this_item: 8in1 Flavours Skewer Bites are a tasty rewarding snack in bite form, in three flavours: chicken breast, duck breast and chicken liver. The best part of a skewer in a perfect bite size, ideal as an instant reward for dogs. Rich in protein and low in fat, oven baked, with no added sugar and no flavour enhancers, GMOs or artificial preservatives. Suitable for dogs of all sizes. Resealable 100 g pouch.
texts.feeding_instructions: Treats should not exceed 10% of your dog's daily calorie intake. XS dogs (1–5 kg): 1 treat per day. S dogs (5–10 kg): up to 3 treats per day. M dogs (10–25 kg): up to 5 treats per day. L dogs (over 25 kg): up to 12 treats per day.
